title: Supervisor de operações Logísticas
description:

Sua atuação envolve acompanhamento da rotina, priorização de demandas, controle de indicadores, tratativa de desvios e interface constante com as demais áreas da empresa. 1. Demandas Operacionais – Customer Service  Conferir e atualizar o GRID, incluindo backlog e cargas do dia; Ajustar e manter os perfis dos assistentes na plataforma de atendimento; Monitorar a fila de atendimentos da coleta, garantindo atualização adequada da equipe; Garantir a periodicidade e pontualidade dos status reports enviados aos clientes; Acompanhar e validar a atualização dos status de pedidos, coletas e entregas nos controles operacionais; Acompanhar as tratativas de ocorrências em aberto, garantindo evolução e retorno dentro do prazo; Distribuir e priorizar as demandas entre a equipe, equilibrando volume e criticidade dos atendimentos; Realizar follow-up com clientes estratégicos ou de maior impacto, antecipando desvios e prestando esclarecimentos; Garantir que PODs e demais documentos obrigatórios sejam coletados, conferidos e enviados dentro do prazo; Validar o conteúdo de relatórios e KPIs antes do envio ao cliente; Acompanhar e apoiar a equipe em tempo real, orientando conduções e priorizações; Garantir que o BI da área esteja atualizado com as informações inseridas pela jovem aprendiz ou estagiária; Acompanhar, em conjunto com o supervisor de Captação, o cumprimento das janelas de embarque. Registrar, acompanhar e tratar não conformidades relacionadas ao atendimento, propondo ajustes de processo ou conduta; Atualizar e padronizar scripts de atendimento e fluxos internos, buscando produtividade e qualidade; Participar de reuniões de resultado com clientes e Diretoria; Elaborar planos de ação para indicadores com baixa performance.  2. Demandas Operacionais – Cadastro, Gestão de Risco e Seguros  Acompanhar a produtividade da equipe e o cumprimento dos SLAs da área; Supervisionar a análise de risco operacional antes da viagem; Identificar a necessidade de isca, escolta, rastreamento ou restrições específicas, conforme perfil da carga, rota e operação; Solicitar e acompanhar embarques esporádicos, quando aplicável; Atualizar os custos relacionados a seguros e gerenciamento de risco no controle da área; Manter comunicação direta com a gerenciadora de risco, alinhando aprovações, regras e exceções; Garantir aderência ao Plano de Gerenciamento de Risco (PGR); Atualizar o arquivo oficial do PGR sempre que houver revisão ou entrada de novo cliente; Acompanhar embarques de maior criticidade ou risco elevado; Conduzir a regulação de sinistros, incluindo: abertura do sinistro junto à seguradora; levantamento dos documentos obrigatórios; acompanhamento da análise da seguradora; follow up com clientes semanalmente; atuação para evitar perda de prazo ou negativa por falha documental; monitoramento do desfecho e da indenização; Controlar as apólices vigentes da transportadora, realizar abertura de BID e receber propostas de corretoras; Acompanhar a averbação das cargas (análise por amostragem), garantindo conformidade do processo; Organizar rotina da área e priorizar atividades críticas, direcionando urgências e exceções; Manter interface constante com todas as áreas envolvidas na operação; Controlar os bloqueios de motoristas com baixa performance  3. Demandas de Gestão  Realizar a gestão de pessoas da equipe sob sua responsabilidade;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) ServiceNow
description:

Já pensou em Somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?  Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais. Você soma com nosso crescimento!  Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe. Sobre a área  Atuar como referência técnica e funcional da plataforma ServiceNow , sendo responsável pela sustentação avançada, evolução contínua e governança da solução, assegurando alta disponibilidade, qualidade dos serviços e aderência aos processos de Gestão de Serviços de TI (ITSM). O profissional atua de forma autônoma e consultiva, liderando tecnicamente demandas de média e alta complexidade, desenvolvimentos no ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code , automações de workflows, integrações e iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de Inteligência Artificial , garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos de auditoria, segurança da informação e boas práticas de mercado (ITIL). No seu dia a dia você focará em:  Sustentação e Operação ITSM  Atuar de forma sênior na sustentação da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade das entregas; Atuar nos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD) , assegurando correta execução, priorização, categorização, registro e encerramento; Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico para chamados de maior complexidade.  Evolução da Plataforma e Desenvolvimento  Desenvolver, evoluir e manter soluções utilizando ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code;  Atuar com Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies e Catalog Items , garantindo aderência às boas práticas da plataforma; Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais de mudanças, releases, upgrades e novas funcionalidades; Conduzir e revisar testes técnicos e funcionais, garantindo qualidade antes de implantações em produção.  Análise, Melhoria Contínua e Governança  Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) , propondo e implementando soluções definitivas para incidentes recorrentes. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, dados e fluxos da plataforma; Garantir aderência a controles internos, auditorias, compliance e segurança da informação.   Integrações, Automação e IA  Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de integrações entre ServiceNow e sistemas corporativos , utilizando IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;  Liderar iniciativas de automação de processos e workflows , reduzindo atividades manuais e aumentando eficiência operacional; Utilizar e orientar o uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial e automação  (ex.: Virtual Agent, assistentes, sugestões automáticas), garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade, privacidade e segurança.  Relacionamento, Comunicação e Liderança Técnica  Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, fornecedores e consultorias, entendendo necessidades e traduzindo em soluções técnicas; Atuar como referência técnica  para analistas juniores e plenos, apoiando no desenvolvimento técnico da equipe; Garantir documentação técnica e funcional completa e atualizada (processos, integrações, manuais e registros de mudanças).  Para esta posição procuramos talentos que tenham:  ServiceNow (Avançado):  sustentação, administração e evolução da plataforma; ITSM:  domínio dos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD); ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code (Avançado):  desenvolvimento e customizações; Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts e UI Policies;  Integrações:  experiência com IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP; ITIL:  sólidos conhecimentos aplicados à operação e melhoria contínua; Governança e Compliance:  atuação em ambientes corporativos com auditorias e controles internos; Automação e IA:  experiência prática ou liderança técnica em iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de IA na plataforma; Certificações:  Trilha CSA (Certified ServiceNow Administrator); Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas; Visão sistêmica e pensamento analítico; Autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e senso de dono; Comunicação clara, postura consultiva e relacionamento interpessoal; Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e mentor; Organização, foco em qualidade, governança e melhoria contínua.  Oferecemos uma proposta de remuneração fixa e variável competitiva, além de uma série de benefícios, veja alguns deles:  Plano de saúde Plano odontológico VA e VR valores competitivos com o mercado Auxílio Farmácia Licença familiar e Kit Ultra Família, 180 dias para licença maternidade e 20 dias para licença paternidade. title: U.S. Immigration Paralegal/Case Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando U.S. Immigration Paralegal/Case Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Company Description  Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U.S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. The firm focuses on high-skill, business, and investment-based immigration, working with founders, executives, researchers, creatives, and investors looking to build their lives and careers in the U.S. via pathways such as the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1A, and E-2. We prioritize thoughtful positioning and effective solutions to achieve durable immigration outcomes.  Role Description  This is a full-time, remote role for an Immigration Case Manager (Paralegal), with a focus on visas including the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and E-2. The case manager will assist in immigration case preparation, including communicating with clients, performing legal research, drafting support letters, and completing immigration forms. Responsibilities include working with clients to gather necessary documents, providing updates on case status, and maintaining accurate and organized electronic filing systems. The role also involves calendaring deadlines, ensuring timely submissions, and collaborating directly with attorneys to ensure a smooth and efficient case process.  Qualifications  Experience with EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, or E-2 visas Strong legal research, case management, and document preparation skills Experience in drafting professional correspondence and support letters Excellent organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail capabilities Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with clients Proficiency in legal or office software systems and tools Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks or deadlines  What we offer  Supportive and collaborative team environment Competitive salary and vacation policy Opportunities for learning and advancement Fully remote work environment A real seat at the table on a small, high-performing team Work that matters. Every petition you help file is someone's career, family reunification, or major life transition.  We look forward to hearing from you!

Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:  Fazer acontecer:  A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito.  Jogar limpo:  Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente:  Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido:  Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro:  Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1:  Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho.  Feito é melhor que perfeito:  A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.    Qual o desafio?  Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.   O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?  A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.    O que esperamos de você?  Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe:  Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação:  Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas:  Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia:  Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.    Quais são os requisitos?  Experiência de 3+ anos  em desenvolvimento de software; Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript  em produção  Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem; Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ); Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS  e/ou Next.js; Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID); Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código; Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.  Será um diferencial:  Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços; Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform; Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.); Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2); Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.    O que oferecemos? Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Linux Systems Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Linux Systems Engineer  Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role  We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own  Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.  03 What you bring  MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.  NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.  04 The kind of engineer this work asks for  Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for  APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem. Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud:  Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform). Histórico de Liderança Técnica:  Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes. Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis:  Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.  #SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts. Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value. Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision. Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution. Advanced English   Required Qualifications:  Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue. Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow). AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems. C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level. Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models. Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.  Preferred Qualifications:  Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator. Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google. Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.  Work Environment: A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results. High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google). Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.  A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us  Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description  As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  • Strong Python skills  • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  • Real production experience with ML on AWS  • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  • Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  • A strong eye for correctness and data quality  • Business level English  • The ability to work independently in a small remote team  • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  • 12 month B2B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado. Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto. O pacote • Salário fixo: R$ 1.830 • Ajuda de custo: R$ 300 • Bônus mensal de até R$ 300 (por desempenho e comportamento) • Plano de saúde • Regime CLT, 100% remoto Total possível inicial: até R$ 2.430/mês + plano de saúde. Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos. A vaga em uma frase Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts. A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro. É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar. Como você vai trabalhar Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades. Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter: • Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição • Boa internet • Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado • Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você. O que estamos buscando Três coisas — em ordem de importância: 1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos. 2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço. 3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor. >>>Teste prático (Passo 1) Vídeo de explicação do teste:  A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo: • Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil) • Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil) • Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam? O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis). P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação. Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis): Vídeo 1:  Vídeo 2:  Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação. Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons. Critérios de avaliação: • Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia • Título / Headline escrito • Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait • Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir • Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples • Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído Referências de vídeos curtos:         >>>Como se candidatar (por e-mail) Envie o teste feito para:  •   •   Assunto: Vaga Editor de Vídeo Júnior — (Seu Nome)  Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo  Para quem essa vaga não é  • Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo • Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar • Quem reage a feedback como ataque • Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente Para quem essa vaga é  • Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido • Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar • Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto

In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation. Responsibilities:  Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.  Your profile:  5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.  **Please submit your CV in English. Our Values:  A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring  What we offer:  At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board. Other Benefits:  Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy. Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:

About Headshots.com   At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth. We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting. About the Role   This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well. We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed. Key Responsibilities  Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business. Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms. Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue.  Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library.  Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early. Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.  What You Bring  Experience & Qualifications Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams. 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus) Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements. Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment. Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements.  Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.   Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.  Why Join Us   Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies. IMPORTANT  Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. Compensation:  $40-60/hour depending on experience

title: Lead Product Designer
description:

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion. We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities. Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth. Position OverviewWe are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence. This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide. As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends. ResponsibilitiesThe selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities. Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities. In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection. Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture. What Makes This Opportunity DifferentAt IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow. Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms. Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth. We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems. Preferred QualificationsWe are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role. Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important. Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement. You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion. Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Product Owner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos  A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.  Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.  O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?  Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.  Nosso Cliente  Esta oportunidade atenderá um importante grupo brasileiro do segmento industrial , com forte atuação nacional e foco contínuo em transformação digital, inovação e evolução de processos corporativos.  O projeto está inserido em um contexto estratégico, com atuação próxima às áreas de negócio e tecnologia, envolvendo iniciativas que exigem visão de produto, organização de demandas, capacidade de priorização e condução de times em ambientes ágeis e corporativos complexos.   O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho  Atuar como ponte estratégica entre negócio, stakeholders e times de tecnologia Definir visão de produto e apoiar a construção de roadmap e planejamento de entregas Criar, detalhar e priorizar itens do Product Backlog  garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio Traduzir necessidades e demandas em requisitos claros, estruturados e acionáveis para o time técnico Conduzir refinamentos de backlog, definição de critérios de aceite e acompanhamento das entregas Garantir organização, clareza e transparência das demandas junto às squads Apoiar a evolução contínua do produto através do acompanhamento de métricas, entregas e indicadores Atuar em ambientes ágeis, apoiando a fluidez e disciplina dos ritos Scrum  Facilitar cerimônias como Sprint Planning, Daily, Sprint Review e Retrospectivas  quando necessário Promover colaboração entre áreas e incentivar troca de conhecimento entre negócio e desenvolvimento   O que você precisa ter   Experiência consolidada atuando como Product Owner  em ambientes ágeis Vivência prática com Scrum  e atuação próxima a squads multidisciplinares Forte capacidade de priorização, organização e gestão de backlog Experiência na interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia Habilidade para conduzir alinhamentos com múltiplos stakeholders em ambientes corporativos complexos Experiência com escrita de user stories , refinamento funcional e definição de critérios de aceite Capacidade de apoiar a organização e fluidez dos ritos ágeis do time   Será um destaque seu perfil com:  Inglês avançado  para interação em ambientes corporativos e alinhamentos com diferentes stakeholders Experiência prévia em projetos ou ambientes SAP  Certificações ágeis como CSPO, PSPO, CSM  ou similares Perfil colaborativo, com boa energia e facilidade para compartilhar conhecimento Capacidade de influenciar, engajar e gerar conexão entre áreas técnicas e de negócio Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e evolução de processos corporativos Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua   Onde você vai trabalhar?  Celebramos a troca, as relações e o poder do contato.  Modelo de trabalho híbrido , com atuação em Curitiba/PR  ou São Paulo/SP (Vila Leopoldina) . É necessário ter disponibilidade para atuação presencial de 3 a 4 vezes por semana  em uma dessas localidades. ⚠️ Importante:  embora a vaga possa aparecer como remota na plataforma, buscamos profissionais residentes na região ou com disponibilidade para mudança.

description:

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead  para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota . Principais Responsabilidades:  Atuação Estratégica e Técnica  Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features). Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance. Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure). Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance. Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros. Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio. Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis. Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma. Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados. Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.  Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:  Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory). Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio. Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights). Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados. Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos. Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.  Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)  Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos. Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory. Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes). Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma. Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible). Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala). Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes. Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP. Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto. Inglês fluente.  Diferenciais  Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse. Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade. Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  Formação e Experiência  Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on). Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success. Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys. Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution. THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.  Be fully aligned to our core values: Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  WHAT WE OFFER  Trust  in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.  Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Conhecimento em Cloud Azure. Experiência com programação/scripting utilizando Python e Java. Conhecimentos em infraestrutura Windows. Capacidade analítica e habilidade para resolução de problemas complexos. Inglês avançado para suporte e interação com times globais.

title: AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Empresa está contratando AI Implementation Lead (Technical PM for Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead  to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm : a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do  Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution.  On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod.  Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed.  You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle.  You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are  You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if  You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if  You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location  Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. How to apply  To apply, please email  (not DM) the following directly to   and copy  :  Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned  In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery  We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment. Responsibilities  Active Sourcing  Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates  Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.  Candidate Outreach  Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow  Pipeline Management  Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting  What Success Looks Like  Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time  Requirements  Must Have  1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously   Strong Plus  Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools  Work Requirements  ⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST   Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)   Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required) Who This Role Is For (& Not For)  This Role Is For You If:  You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time  This Role Is NOT For You If:  You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only  Compensation & Benefits  Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction Fully remote : work from anywhere PTO : 2 Weeks Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:  one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.   Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.   Coaching credits:  $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development  Ready to Apply?  If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.
